microtheory.name: nonclassical_logic
microtheory.definition: Logics rejecting classical principles. Intuitionistic (no excluded middle), paraconsistent (tolerating contradiction), fuzzy (degrees of truth), relevance (true implication requires relevance), substructural (rejecting weakening + contraction). Substrate analogue: substrate's non-binary reasoning modes.

concepts.name: intuitionistic_logic
concepts.definition: Brouwer + Heyting. Rejects excluded middle: ¬(P ∨ ¬P) consistent with intuitionism. Constructive proof required. Substrate analogue: substrate's constructive-evidence requirement.

concepts.name: bhk_interpretation
concepts.definition: Brouwer-Heyting-Kolmogorov. Proof of P ∧ Q = pair of proofs; proof of P → Q = function from proofs of P to proofs of Q. Substrate analogue: substrate's constructive proof structure.

concepts.name: law_of_excluded_middle_rejection
concepts.definition: Intuitionists reject P ∨ ¬P as universal. May lack proof of either. Substrate analogue: substrate's σ-near-zero state.

concepts.name: constructive_existence
concepts.definition: Intuitionistic ∃x P(x) requires constructible witness. Substrate analogue: substrate's instantiable-existence.

concepts.name: curry_howard_correspondence
concepts.definition: Propositions = types; proofs = programs. Intuitionistic logic = lambda calculus. Substrate analogue: substrate's proof-as-Term-tree.

concepts.name: paraconsistent_logic
concepts.definition: Tolerates some contradictions without explosion. ex falso quodlibet rejected. Da Costa, Priest. Substrate analogue: substrate's local-contradiction tolerance.

concepts.name: dialetheism
concepts.definition: Priest. Some contradictions are true. Liar paradox case. Substrate analogue: substrate's both-true-and-false claims.

concepts.name: explosion_principle
concepts.definition: Ex falso quodlibet. From contradiction, anything follows. Classical logic. Rejected by paraconsistent. Substrate analogue: substrate's avoidance of inconsistency-cascade.

concepts.name: fuzzy_logic
concepts.definition: Zadeh 1965. Truth values in [0,1]. Continuous. Many-valued. Substrate analogue: substrate's σ-continuous truth.

concepts.name: fuzzy_set
concepts.definition: Membership function valued in [0,1] rather than {0,1}. Substrate analogue: substrate's partial Concept membership.

concepts.name: linguistic_variable
concepts.definition: Variable taking values like 'tall', 'somewhat tall', 'very tall'. Substrate analogue: substrate's gradient-Concept assignment.

concepts.name: fuzzy_inference
concepts.definition: Rule-based reasoning with fuzzy premises + conclusions. Used in control systems. Substrate analogue: substrate's gradient inference.

concepts.name: relevance_logic
concepts.definition: Anderson + Belnap. Implication requires relevance. P → Q only if P + Q share content. Substrate analogue: substrate's relevant-inference constraint.

concepts.name: ticket_entailment
concepts.definition: Anderson + Belnap system T. Captures relevance. Substrate analogue: substrate's content-preserving inference.

concepts.name: paradoxes_of_material_implication
concepts.definition: False antecedent makes implication trivially true. 'If 2+2=5, then I'm a monkey'. Relevance logic addresses. Substrate analogue: substrate's avoidance of vacuous truth.

concepts.name: linear_logic
concepts.definition: Girard 1987. Resources consumed by use. Each premise used exactly once. Substrate analogue: substrate's resource-aware inference.

concepts.name: structural_rules
concepts.definition: Weakening (add premise), contraction (combine duplicates), exchange (reorder). Various logics drop some. Substrate analogue: substrate's contextual inference rules.

concepts.name: lambek_calculus
concepts.definition: Categorial grammar's logic. Substructural — no exchange. Substrate analogue: substrate's order-sensitive composition.

concepts.name: many_valued_logic_systems
concepts.definition: Łukasiewicz, Kleene. 3-valued (true, false, unknown). Substrate analogue: substrate's known-status options.

concepts.name: lukasiewicz_logic
concepts.definition: Łukasiewicz 1920s. Continuous truth values, max-min operations. Substrate analogue: substrate's continuous logic.

concepts.name: kleene_three_valued
concepts.definition: Strong + weak three-valued logic. True, false, undefined. Substrate analogue: substrate's data-incomplete reasoning.

concepts.name: probabilistic_logic
concepts.definition: Truth values are probabilities. Reasoning under uncertainty. Substrate analogue: substrate's Bayesian inference.

concepts.name: default_logic
concepts.definition: Reiter. Default rules. 'Birds normally fly'. Reasoning with assumptions. Substrate analogue: substrate's default-Concept activation.

concepts.name: nonmonotonic_logic
concepts.definition: Adding premises can DEFEAT conclusions. Real-world reasoning is nonmonotonic. Substrate analogue: substrate's belief-revision capability.

concepts.name: belief_revision
concepts.definition: AGM. Updating belief set with new info. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-update mechanism.

concepts.name: quantum_logic
concepts.definition: Birkhoff + von Neumann 1936. Logic of quantum mechanics. Lattice not distributive. Substrate analogue: substrate's non-classical correlations.

rules.name: intuitionistic_requires_construction
rules.head: the substrate proves ∃x P(x) intuitionistically
rules.body: it must construct a specific witness. Mere non-existence-of-nonexistence insufficient. Substrate's constructive existence.

rules.name: paraconsistent_localizes_contradiction
rules.head: the substrate detects local contradiction
rules.body: explosion is blocked — inference outside contradiction zone proceeds normally. Substrate's inconsistency containment.

rules.name: fuzzy_logic_handles_vagueness
rules.head: the substrate reasons about vague predicates
rules.body: fuzzy logic assigns gradient membership. 'Tall' becomes degree, not binary. Substrate's gradient categorization.

rules.name: relevance_blocks_vacuous_implications
rules.head: the substrate evaluates P → Q with unrelated content
rules.body: relevance logic blocks the implication. Material-implication paradoxes avoided. Substrate's content-sensitive inference.

rules.name: nonmonotonic_reasoning_defeats_with_new_info
rules.head: the substrate has a default conclusion + new information defeats it
rules.body: the conclusion is withdrawn. Substrate's belief-revision capability.
